subject: Request for temporary eval voucher — PO delayed in finance
messages:
From: Simon Keller <simon.keller@medivance.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot at risk — PO stuck with finance

Hi Alex,

Quick note — our procurement team has routed the PO for the pilot through an extra finance review and it’s blocking approvals. Legal and procurement say it should clear this week but I don’t have a hard ETA. The sandbox we’re running will lapse if we don’t extend access.

Can Redwood temporarily re-open the sandbox or provide a short voucher so our engineering team can complete the validation? If not, we’ll likely lose momentum.

PO ref: MV-2026-4479 (attached)

Thanks,
Simon
Simon Keller
Head of Platform Engineering — MediVance
[simon.keller@medivance.com]

Attachment: purchase_order.pdf (stub)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot at risk — PO stuck with finance

Simon — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO reference. I’m sorry for the friction here — totally understand the urgency.

I’m going to pull in our CS lead and my manager to get a temporary solution in place while finance clears the PO. Can you confirm the scope you need kept active (team size / API calls per day) so I make sure we don’t inadvertently exceed what we can approve?

If you can’t share numbers right now, a short 72-hour voucher is usually what we can offer quickly while procurement finishes. Will confirm internally and get back to you within the day.

— Alex

Date: 2026-10-01T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot at risk — PO stuck with finance

Forwarding Simon’s note and the attached PO (purchase_order.pdf). Deal RDW-8893 — MediVance’s pilot will lapse if we don’t extend access. They’ve asked for a short bridging voucher while their PO moves through finance.

Request: Approve up to a 72-hour eval voucher (no additional credits beyond what’s needed to keep the sandbox live). We should log the voucher in HubSpot and mark the justification (procurement delay).

Why: Customer is mid-evaluation, outcome looks promising; losing live session risks derailing the timeline and extension to Dedicated.

Constraints if approved:
- Voucher limited to 72 hours and tied to the account (no transfer).
- Add note to deal and include PO reference MV-2026-4479.
- CS (Monica) to own issuance and monitoring.

Simon — tagging Laura and Monica for approval.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex — approved with guardrails.

Please proceed with a 72-hour voucher only. Make sure:
- It’s recorded against RDW-8893 in HubSpot (put MV-2026-4479 in the ticket).
- Tag this as a one-off courtesy due to procurement; do not change list pricing or commit to extended credits until PO clears.
- CS to monitor usage and alert me if they exceed expected consumption.

Monica — can you create the voucher and send confirmation to Simon with the voucher code + link to the onboarding doc? Also attach the stubbed voucher file for his records.

Laura
